name: Fluminense 2023
scopeNote: Brazilian calendar year 2023, all competitions: 72 matches per en.wikipedia (Carioca 15 - won, Copa do Brasil 4, Libertadores 13 - won, Serie A 38, Club World Cup 2 - runners-up). First match Resende 0-2 Fluminense (Carioca, 14 Jan 2023); last match Manchester City 4-0 Fluminense (Club World Cup final, 22 Dec 2023). Fernando Diniz (id fernando-diniz, appointed 2022) managed the whole year; no other manager appears on the season page. Diniz also coached Brazil on an interim basis in parallel from mid-2023, which is ignored here; Lance (2023-09-06) reports that assistant Marcão would run Fluminense training during the Sept 4-12 FIFA window, and that the next fixture (Vasco, 16 Sept) was after the break, so no match was found under Marcão (the Lance piece is a plan, not proof; the pt.wikipedia season page was not read). Style: 'Dinizismo' (Lance, 2023-11-03) with an 'aposicional' system (Lance, 2023-11-02); 'relationism' is a later outside label (The Blizzard, 2025).
openQuestions: Marking (zonal vs man-oriented), pressing height and block depth are not documented for 2023 by any source read; only Diniz's 2025 podcast claim that Fluminense defended well in high, medium and low lines. Treat blo and mar as memory-based.
Width and full-back patterns, transitions and set pieces: no 2023 source read (the only width piece is April 2024).
Sources disagree on adaptation: Lance 2023-11-02 says Diniz does not usually adapt to the opponent; Lance 2023-11-03 says he adapted when needed. Weigh in the audit.

Confirm via ge or the official Fluminense site that Marcão did not lead any competitive match in 2023 and that the Serie A finish (7th per en.wikipedia vs 3rd in the Lance 2023-11-03 text, written before the season ended) is only a mid-season snapshot.

sources.title: 2023 Fluminense FC season
sources.evidence: Used for dates and totals only (read in two parts, offsets 0 and 100000). Infobox manager: "Fernando Diniz". First match 14 January 2023 Resende 0-2 Fluminense (Carioca); last 22 December 2023 Club World Cup final Manchester City 4-0 Fluminense. Competitions: Carioca (winners), Copa do Brasil (round of 16), Serie A (7th per page), Libertadores (winners), Club World Cup (runners-up). "72 (15 Carioca, 4 Copa do Brasil, 13 Copa Libertadores, 38 Série A, 2 Club World Cup)". No other manager, caretaker or interim named anywhere in the page text read.

sources.title: Quatro atacantes? Saiba como Diniz pode escalar o Fluminense contra o Boca Juniors na Libertadores
sources.evidence: Diniz's main option is a 4-3-3, "sistema mais utilizado durante a primeira metade da temporada"; alternative 4-2-4, which the article says was used to beat Olimpia and Internacional.

sources.title: Quatro atacantes? Saiba como Diniz pode escalar o Fluminense contra o Boca Juniors na Libertadores
sources.evidence: Diniz's "aposicional" system, where "os jogadores têm total liberdade de movimentação" to get closer to the ball and create passing options.

sources.title: Quatro atacantes? Saiba como Diniz pode escalar o Fluminense contra o Boca Juniors na Libertadores
sources.evidence: Diniz "é conhecido como um treinador que não costuma adaptar o seu time ao adversário" (author suggests he may rethink it for the Boca final).

sources.title: Quatro atacantes? Saiba como Diniz pode escalar o Fluminense contra o Boca Juniors na Libertadores
sources.evidence: Pre-match speculation only: "André poderia acompanhar Barco por todo o campo, em marcação individual". A hypothesis for the final, not observed behaviour; does not close the marking gap.

sources.title: Diego Lugano sobre Fernando Diniz: su particular estilo (final Libertadores)
sources.evidence: Lugano (ex-Boca/Uruguay player, commentator) says Fluminense keeps the ball at the back so the rival presses near its own goal, leaving space behind its midfielders; Diniz wants to wrap the rival with touches from the back, no fixed positions, high mobility, speed in the last third; "arriesga bastante más" than other teams near its own box. Paraphrased from the page; an opinion by an outside commentator, no verbatim quote captured.

sources.title: Diego Lugano sobre Fernando Diniz: su particular estilo (final Libertadores)
sources.evidence: Same article: Diniz seeks to wrap the opponent through passing from the back and does not keep fixed positions (paraphrase of Lugano). No possession numbers.

sources.title: Com ajuda de Diniz, Ganso dá a volta por cima e vira trunfo do Fluminense na final da Libertadores
sources.evidence: "O estilo único de Diniz em dominar a posse de bola através da saída curta fez Ganso retomar a confiança."

sources.title: Com ajuda de Diniz, Ganso dá a volta por cima e vira trunfo do Fluminense na final da Libertadores
sources.evidence: Ganso is the "cérebro do Tricolor das Laranjeiras que conseguiu reviver sua carreira com a ajuda de Fernando Diniz"; Diniz once said Ganso's genius was superior to Xavi's.

sources.title: Entre tapas e beijos, Diniz se reinventa no Fluminense e chega preparado para a final da Libertadores
sources.evidence: Diniz "se adaptou quando necessário, entendeu as adversidades" during the Libertadores; the semi-final v Internacional was "uma virada histórica no Beira-Rio". Contradicts, partly, the Lance 2023-11-02 claim that he does not adapt.

sources.title: Entre tapas e beijos, Diniz se reinventa no Fluminense e chega preparado para a final da Libertadores
sources.evidence: "O treinador conseguiu potencializar os principais jogadores do elenco (André, Ganso, Arias e Cano)"; the "Dinizismo" settled in ("Com o "Dinizismo" encaixado").

sources.title: Entre tapas e beijos, Diniz se reinventa no Fluminense e chega preparado para a final da Libertadores
Felipe Melo relembra críticas ao lado esquerdo do Fluminense e rebate: seguimos
sources.evidence: Diniz "passou a improvisar o volante como zagueiro pelo lado esquerdo nesta temporada" (Felipe Melo, a veteran, and Marcelo, both older). Felipe Melo: "Eu lembro que quando começou a temporada o Diniz me deu a oportunidade lá em Lima para jogar"; "É um lado muito vulnerável e os times vão jogar daquele lado".

sources.title: Felipe Melo relembra críticas ao lado esquerdo do Fluminense e rebate: seguimos
sources.evidence: Diniz improvised a defensive midfielder (Felipe Melo) as left-sided centre-back; critics said that side lacked mobility and protection.

sources.title: Diniz, Fluminense, Brazil and the fragile rise of the pioneer of relationism
sources.evidence: General description of Diniz's teams, not tied to 2023: "When the ball is lost, counter-pressing must win it back as quickly as possible." Retrospective and not period-specific, so unverified for the 2023 profile.

sources.title: Diniz, Fluminense, Brazil and the fragile rise of the pioneer of relationism
sources.evidence: "Using the keeper as a player, he likes his team to build up from the back." Diniz generally, not tied to 2023; goalkeeper Fábio was the oldest Libertadores winner (final of 2023-11-04).

sources.title: Entenda a mudança de Diniz que foi a chave de melhora do Fluminense (Trivela)
sources.evidence: Out of period (Fluminense 2-1 Vasco, April 2024): "Os laterais Marcelo e Samuel Xavier puderam participar mais da construção por dentro e ganharam espaço nas pontas." Kept as context only.

statedView.quote: O cara acha que variação tática é baixar a linha. E o Fluminense marcava muito bem em linha alta, linha média e linha baixa. Contra o Boca Juniors, jogamos com um a menos, marcamos em linha baixa e os caras não fizeram nada.
statedView.note: Podcast Charla interview, reported by Super Rádio Tupi on 2025-02-14; about his Fluminense, said after the period.

statedView.quote: Campeão é quem vive com dignidade, quem respeita, trabalha com amor, e foi até o fim.
statedView.note: Soccerway page has no explicit date; said after the 4 Nov 2023 final. About values, not tactics.

confidence.reason: All verified evidence is tier C press from early Nov 2023 (Lance, ESPN Deportes, Correio) around the Libertadores final; no tier A-B season analysis was read (Sky Sports returned 410, Man City scout report 403). Pressing, block, marking, width, transitions and set pieces have no verified 2023 fact.
